name: THE RACCOON
note: THE RACCOON (doc 05: 'He is in my hole. He was in my hole before it was my hole, which he clearly regards as decisive'). Room-23 operation 3's sheet, cut by tools/art/room23-raccoon.py, sitting in the mouth of the hole. No tree of his own: THE RACCOON hotspot over him opens RAC_A1 on the first TALK TO and carries his name after it (errata 96 E). When the blanket turns the hole cold he 'leaves at a walk' (doc 54 A5): his exit.

sprite.frameNote: 0 rest · 1 breath · 2 his head turned to look left · 3 eating. A break every `breakEvery` seconds (errata 77).

exit.note: Doc 54 A5: 'The raccoon emerges, gives Thad one look of complete contempt, and leaves at a walk' -- along the slope and off the frame at the right.
